title: G45 · 拒绝
body: I changed only wordFreqTopK, preserving the champion’s proven tokenizer and stable-ID counter while replacing its vocabulary-wide pair allocation and callback-based ranking with exact count-cutoff selection, per-frequency groups, callback-free lexical sorting, and pair creation only for returned entries; this removes up to roughly 1,400 unnecessary pair allocations and substantial comparator work on the holdout vocabulary, while preserving count-descending and lexical tie semantics exactly.
